newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: PRESS DIGEST - S.Korean newspapers - March 25.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - S.Korean newspapers - March 25.

text.p: The following is a summary of major stories in leading South Korean newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Seoul. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.

- The Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy said on Monday that the prices of liquefied natural gas and petroleum gas will increase starting on Tuesday due to higher taxes and the weakening Korean won among other factors.
- Rhee In-je governor of Kyonggi Province, formally announced on Monday that he will enter the ruling New Korea Party's presidential nomination race.
- Seven banks get central Bank of Korea lifeline: Overseas branches receive $1 billion in emergency loans
- Prosecutors are set to summon lawmakers as well as government officials for questioning on the loans-for-bribes scandal involving the Hanbo Group, a prosecution source said on Monday.
- The six largest cities, including Seoul, face strike of bus labor unions starting on Wednesday.
